name: Automated Refund Investigation – Fraud & Approval Checks

parameters.content:
## Automated Refund Investigation Engine

Receives a refund request, runs fraud risk scoring, performs multi-level approval checks, and returns a final refund decision with full audit trail.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Refund Request – Receives the refund investigation payload via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Score Fraud Risk – Validates the request and calculates fraud risk score + required approval levels.
3. Wait - Pre Fraud Check – Short pause before external fraud service call.
4. HTTP Request - Fraud Service Check – Calls external fraud / risk scoring API.
5. Wait - Pre Level 1 Approval – Pause before Level-1 (support / auto) approval check.
6. HTTP Request - Level 1 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-1 approver.
7. Wait - Pre Level 2 Approval – Pause before Level-2 (finance / risk) approval check.
8. HTTP Request - Level 2 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-2 approver.
9. HTTP Request - Process Refund / Reject – Executes the refund or records rejection at payment gateway.
10. Code - Build Final Decision – Aggregates fraud score + approval results into final approve/reject decision + audit trail.
11. Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete investigation report to the caller.

## 1. Intake & Fraud Risk Scoring

Webhook - Refund Request – Receives the refund investigation payload via POST.
Code - Validate & Score Fraud Risk – Validates the request and calculates fraud risk score + required approval levels.

## 2. Fraud Service + Multi-Level Approval

Wait - Pre Fraud Check – Short pause before external fraud service call.
HTTP Request - Fraud Service Check – Calls external fraud / risk scoring API.
Wait - Pre Level 1 Approval – Pause before Level-1 (support / auto) approval check.
HTTP Request - Level 1 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-1 approver.
Wait - Pre Level 2 Approval – Pause before Level-2 (finance / risk) approval check.
HTTP Request - Level 2 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-2 approver.
HTTP Request - Process Refund / Reject – Executes the refund or records rejection at payment gateway.

## 3. Decision & Respond

Code - Build Final Decision – Aggregates fraud score + approval results into final approve/reject decision + audit trail.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete investigation report to the caller.
